comment: The text says the business-services layer is “no less essential” to a complete, sustainable architecture. This may conflict with REDDHI’s emphasis on prioritising an essential foundational core and may imply that every country ultimately needs every listed component.

anchor.note: p.71 l.Lines 710-712 read as the printed page; section 3.5.3.2 agrees

public.text: The text says the business-services layer is “no less essential” to a complete, sustainable architecture. This may conflict with REDDHI’s emphasis on prioritising an essential foundational core and may imply that every country ultimately needs every listed component.
public.suggestedRevision: State that business-service components become relevant according to national goals, use cases, institutional arrangements, and existing capabilities. Avoid implying universal implementation of every component.
